Mrs. Fisher: I saw the huge red snapper you caught. Good job kid.
You: Thanks.
Mrs. Fisher: It’s a nice, expensive fish that tastes great and is full of vitamins.
Mrs. Fisher: Think it through if you want to eat it or to sell it. 
You: What would you do in my place?
Mrs. Fisher: I would eat it for sure since it might be the last time you get a chance to eat it.
Mrs. Fisher: Red snapper has white meat which makes it easy to counterfeit. Most of the fish labeled as red snapper in your local supermarket are tilapia or some other cheap fish. 
You: Really?
Mrs. Fisher: Even in these premium shops and restaurants it’s very unlikely you will get a real red snapper.
You: I had no idea this was such a big problem.
Mrs. Fisher: Almost half of all the seafood is not as advertised. That’s why if you want the real deal, you gotta catch it yourself.
You: I will do just that.
